project.name: Bwlchgwyn Townscape Guide
project.boundarySource: ONS Built-up Areas (December 2024) with curated adjoining public green spaces
project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-11. Local Cadw and National Monuments Record of Wales data and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 4 directly adjoining public green-space geometries and 0 reviewed visitor extensions were included in the active visitor boundary.

touristAppeal.label: Not a tourist town
touristAppeal.summary: Bwlchgwyn has recorded local interest, but its current in-boundary visitor offer does not meet the threshold for a tourist-town rating.

townGuide.headline: A practical local guide to Bwlchgwyn
townGuide.intro: Bwlchgwyn has a modest visitor offer within its active settlement boundary. The guide records defensible heritage and practical stops without presenting the place as a destination.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Bwlchgwyn centre
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Use the map to understand the settlement and its currently curated public facilities.

townGuide.suggestedTime: As part of a wider local journey
townGuide.visitorMood: A local settlement rather than a tourist destination.

townStudyArea.sourceName: ONS Built-up Areas (December 2024) with curated adjoining public green spaces
